explication: codebase-memory-mcp is a local code-intelligence engine and MCP server for coding agents. An agent requests indexing or structural analysis of a repository; the native server indexes source into a persistent graph, then exposes search, tracing, architecture, impact, coverage, and related tools. The built-in UI explores that graph. The tree and excerpts support the pipeline, grammar/LSP, storage, daemon, and UI layers; many individual MCP tool implementations were not sampled, so their internal dispatch is shown only at the documented boundary.
